input.overview: Complete the P-A-R-T-Y A-N-I-M-A-L letters at their lit playfield shots; the inserts carry between balls and may also carry between games on the installed setup. Completing the phrase starts three-ball Multiball. During Multiball, the number of balls in play controls the 2x or 3x playfield value, so preserve all three and favor the repeatable ramps.
input.simpleOverview: Collect the lit P-A-R-T-Y A-N-I-M-A-L letters around the playfield. Completing the phrase starts three-ball Multiball. Keep all three balls alive for 3x playfield value; after one drains, the remaining two score at 2x. Repeat the safest ramp while the multiplier is high.
input.summary: Complete the lit P-A-R-T-Y A-N-I-M-A-L letters to start three-ball Multiball. Preserve three balls for 3x playfield value, then two balls for 2x, and repeat the safest ramp while the multiplier lasts.

steps.text: Follow the lit inserts and collect every letter in P-A-R-T-Y A-N-I-M-A-L.
Complete the phrase to release the balls and start three-ball Multiball.
Separate and control the balls before attacking the ramps; three live balls give 3x playfield value.
Repeat the safest ramp while three or two balls remain, because the playfield multiplier falls with ball count.

alternatives.title: Work P-I-G-O-U-T
alternatives.when: Use this when its six targets are safer than the current letter shot.

steps.text: Complete the P-I-G-O-U-T targets for their lit feature value.
Return to the flashing PARTY ANIMAL letter after the target feed is controlled.
Outside Multiball, complete the three Jukebox targets to advance the song and collect their feature.
Do not plan a Jukebox collect during Multiball; use that time for multiplied ramp and target scoring.

machineSetup: Confirm whether PARTY ANIMAL letters carry between games, how extra ball and Special convert, and whether locks or letter progress are shared.
Test every PARTY ANIMAL and P-I-G-O-U-T award shot, both ramps, three-ball release, Jukebox targets, all three saucers, toad target, and trough.

cautions.response: Read the inserts at game start instead of assuming the phrase begins empty or retains prior progress.
